0022600005.text: Both the Golden State Warriors and the Los Angeles Lakers open their 2026-27 seasons in this game, with the Warriors on the road and ESPN's matchup predictor giving them a 35% chance to win. Golden State is without Jimmy Butler III (knee, surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (undisclosed), and Moses Moody (knee, surgery), and Brandin Podziemski (back), Charles Bassey (knee), and Stephen Curry (ankle sprain) are day-to-day and game-time decisions, while the Lakers have Adou Thiero (undisclosed), Bronny James (illness), Cameron Carr (undisclosed bruise), Collin Sexton (lower leg), and Jarred Vanderbilt (undisclosed) listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions. The Warriors lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, including a 119-103 loss to the Lakers on April 9, 2026 in San Francisco, and this is the first meeting of 2026-27.
